the reaction of 3-chlorocarbazole with phosphorus pentoxide in dichloroethane at room temperature leads to the formation of 3,6-di-chlorocarazole in high yield.
the reaction of phosphorus pentachioride with carbazole and some derivatives thereof, in 1, 2-dichloroehtane, leads to 3-chiorocarbazoles and 3.6-dichiorocarbazole.
The reaction of carbazole with phosphorus pentoxide in 1, 2-dichlorobenzene leads to the formation of 3-chlorocarbazole and 3, 6-dichloro- carbazole.

the development of novel and efficient methodologies for the synthesis of carbazole and its derivatives.
the synthesis and study of the properties of new compounds containing the carbazole skeleton and their derivatives.
the synthesis of carbazole derivatives.
